issue.title: Checkout returns 500 when the promo code field is left empty
issue.body:
Submitting the checkout form with an empty promo code returns a 500 instead of treating it as no discount.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Add any item to the cart
2. Go to checkout and leave the promo code field blank
3. Click 'Place order'
4. See a 500 error

Expected: an empty promo code is treated as no discount and the order completes. Actual: 500 Internal Server Error.
